I also correct two previous interpretations: 0/1 is strong EA eluent, and m199 is a sulfoxide. Matched m127, m96, m117, m75, and novel m145 pairs establish condition-response shapes instead of adding isolated extreme labels. Carbonyl transition probes test whether corrections learned from late-eluting multifunctional compounds transfer appropriately to conjugated, cyclic, and fused-aromatic environments. The m200 amount-by-ratio experiment, m13 intermediate amount, m206 low-amount point, and m125 loading-volume contrasts separate recorded loading effects from structural and solvent effects. One deliberate m56 repeat addresses a concrete reproducibility question; otherwise, redundant condition duplicates are avoided. Novel m55 and m145 measurements and the simpler malonate probes provide ordinary ester and aldehyde coverage with specific learning questions, rather than diversity alone. Quantile widths are treated only as imperfect single-model signals. This combination should improve generalization across the Row-distribution by learning endpoint-specific structure-condition relationships while limiting broad corrections that would damage already accurate regions."}
